faq.label: Got Questions?
faq.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: How do I book an appointment?
faq.a1: You can book online through our Patient Portal or call our emergency line. Select your preferred doctor, choose a date and time, and confirm your booking.
faq.a2: Yes, we work with major Ethiopian insurance providers including CBE Birr, Awash Insurance, and Nyala Insurance. Contact us to verify your coverage.
faq.q3: What should I bring to my first visit?
faq.a3: Please bring a valid ID, your insurance card if applicable, and any previous medical records or test results relevant to your visit.
faq.a4: Yes, our emergency line (+251 911 22 33 44) is available 24/7. For life-threatening emergencies, please call immediately.
faq.q5: How can I access my medical records?
faq.a5: Registered patients can access their complete medical records through the Patient Portal under 'My Records'.
faq.a6: Our clinics are open Monday–Friday 8AM–6PM and Saturday 9AM–2PM. Emergency services are available 24/7.
faq.q7: Can I reschedule or cancel my appointment?
faq.a7: Yes, you can reschedule or cancel up to 24 hours before your appointment through the Patient Portal or by calling us.
